facts.text: I am working on a social media campaign for a sustainable fashion brand.
I need help finding more niche hashtags to use for our posts.
I want hashtags related to sustainable fashion and eco-friendly living.
I have noticed that our posts perform better on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
I launched the campaign on March 15th.
I have gained around 500 new followers since launching the campaign.
My average engagement per Instagram post has been around 200 likes and 50 comments.
My average engagement per Facebook post has been around 150 likes and 20 shares.
I have been working on this social media campaign for three weeks.
I want to create engaging content for an upcoming giveaway on April 1st.
I want to come up with ideas for the entry requirements for the giveaway.
I want the giveaway entry requirements to be easy for people to enter.
I want the giveaway entry requirements to be aligned with our brand's goals.
I want to use Option 2: Share a Sustainable Fashion Tip for the giveaway entry requirement.
I want the giveaway to encourage people to think about sustainable fashion practices and share their own tips and tricks.
I believe Option 2 is easy to enter and will likely drive user-generated content.

keyphrases: entry requirements Option 2 share a sustainable fashion tip
